API Reference

This document describes the REST API provided by Gestiion.

Base URL

All API endpoints are prefixed with /api/v1/.

Authentication

Most API endpoints require authentication. Use token-based authentication:

Authorization: Token your_token_here

Endpoints

### Authentication

POST /api/v1/auth/login/

Authenticate a user and get an authentication token.

Request Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Request body:

{
  "username": "user@example.com",
  "password": "password123"
}

Response:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "token": "9944b09199c62bcf9418ad846dd0e4bbdfc6ee4b",
  "user": {
    "id": 1,
    "email": "user@example.com",
    "first_name": "John",
    "last_name": "Doe"
  }
}

Clients

GET /api/v1/clients/
Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – Success

Response body:

[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "name": "Client 1",
    "email": "client1@example.com"
  }
]
POST /api/v1/clients/
Request Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 201 Created – Client created

  • 400 Bad Request – Invalid input data

Request body:

{
  "name": "New Client",
  "email": "new@example.com"
}

Response:

HTTP/1.1 201 Created
Content-Type: application/json
Location: /api/v1/clients/2/

{
  "id": 2,
  "name": "New Client",
  "email": "new@example.com"
}
GET /api/v1/clients/:id/
Parameters:

  • id (int) – Client ID

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – Success

  • 404 Not Found – Client not found

Response body:

{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Client 1",
  "email": "client1@example.com"
}
PUT /api/v1/clients/:id/
Parameters:

  • id (int) – Client ID

Request Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – Client updated

  • 400 Bad Request – Invalid input data

  • 404 Not Found – Client not found

Request body:

{
  "name": "Updated Client"
}

Response:

HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "id": 1,
  "name": "Updated Client",
  "email": "client1@example.com"
}
DELETE /api/v1/clients/:id/
Parameters:

  • id (int) – Client ID

Status Codes:

  • 204 No Content – Client deleted

  • 404 Not Found – Client not found

Response:

HTTP/1.1 204 No Content

Projects

GET /api/v1/projects/
Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – Success

POST /api/v1/projects/
Request Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 201 Created – Project created

  • 400 Bad Request – Invalid input data

GET /api/v1/projects/:id/
Parameters:

  • id (int) – Project ID

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – Success

  • 404 Not Found – Project not found

Time Entries

GET /api/v1/time-entries/
Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – Success

POST /api/v1/time-entries/
Request Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 201 Created – Time entry created

  • 400 Bad Request – Invalid input data

Invoices

GET /api/v1/invoices/
Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – Success

POST /api/v1/invoices/
Request Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/json

Status Codes:

  • 201 Created – Invoice created

  • 400 Bad Request – Invalid input data

GET /api/v1/invoices/:id/pdf/
Parameters:

  • id (int) – Invoice ID

Response Headers:

  • Content-Type – application/pdf

Status Codes:

  • 200 OK – PDF generated

  • 404 Not Found – Invoice not found

Error Responses

All API endpoints return standard HTTP status codes. In case of an error, the response body will contain a JSON object with an error field describing the issue.

Example error response (400 Bad Request):

{
  "error": "Invalid input data",
  "details": {
    "email": ["This field is required."]
  }
}
